problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ b & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

The matrix of the quadratic form $Q(x)=-2{x}_{1}^{2}-10{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-3{x}_{2}^{2}\,$ is given above. What is the value of $a+b?$
worked_solution:
Since the matrix of the quadratic form must be symmetric, we rewrite our expression as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}Q(x) & =-2{x}_{1}^{2}-10{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-3{x}_{2}^{2} \\  & =(-2){x}_{1}^{2}+(-5){x}_{1}{x}_{2} \\  & +\,(-5){x}_{2}{x}_{1}+(-3){x}_{2}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that to get a symmetric matrix, we must split the coefficient of $-10{x}_{1}{x}_{2}$ between the entries 

$$
{a}_{12}={a}_{21}=\frac{-10}{2}=-5
$$

of our matrix. So, the matrix corresponding to our quadratic form is

$$
[\begin{aligned}-2 & -5 \\ -5 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-2$ and $b=-5.$ Finally, 

$$
a+b=-2+(-5)=-7.
$$
